title_families_note: v2.1 second path, used only when NO strict title/text rule above matched and the text is readable. Reading 1: an upper-case title line of the heading names one or more act families ('title') inside a NEUTRAL FRAME - apart from the family names, the line may contain only 'title_neutral_words' and reference numbers; any other word (OPPOSIZIONE A, REVOCA DELLA, PREAVVISO DI, RISCONTRO A...) may turn the act into a different one, so the title is not understood -> RECUPERARE. Reading 2, independent: the PEC subject names the same family ('subject'), or the text states a relative term that equals the term of that act in rules/terms.json (same start event; same number of days where the act has a statutory one). The type is committed only when exactly ONE family is confirmed; a family that nothing confirms, or two confirmed families, is RECUPERARE - and it also vetoes the weaker subject-only fallback (DT-050..), which stays for documents without a text layer.
